## Change / Változás

Describe the problem, result and validation. / Probléma, eredmény, ellenőrzés.

- [ ] Target is `main`; merge requires review and green CI.
- [ ] I understand commit identity is public; I use GitHub noreply where appropriate.
- [ ] No secrets, real env values, local editor configuration or machine paths.
- [ ] Uploaded media has no forbidden embedded metadata and is at most 10 MiB.
- [ ] Every handwritten page has no name, Neptun identifier, signature or personal data.
- [ ] I have instructor/owner permission and may publish under the applicable license.
- [ ] No legacy hash exception was added/broadened to bypass a failed check.
- [ ] Lint, privacy tests, build and links pass; validation is described below.
- [ ] Dependency/workflow changes are isolated and justified, with minimal permissions.
